question: In which state is New Mangalore port located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The New Mangalore Port is located in the state of **Karnataka**, India.
 
• It is situated in the coastal city of **Mangaluru** (also known as Mangalore).
 
• New Mangalore Port Trust (NMPT) is the **ninth largest port** in India.
 
• This port primarily handles **bulk cargo** including crude oil, petroleum products, and coal.
 
• The port is a significant gateway for the **export of iron ore** from the Kudremukh mines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Ports in India**

 
 
• India has 13 major ports, including Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata.
 
• These ports are crucial for international trade and commerce.
 
• They handle a variety of cargo including containers, bulk, and liquid cargo.
 
• Ports are managed by the Port Trusts under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping, and Waterways.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Ports**
 
 
• Ports facilitate international trade by providing docking, loading, and unloading facilities for ships.
 
• They play a crucial role in the economic development of a country.
 
• Ports are hubs for import and export activities, influencing the local and national economy.
 
• Efficient port operations can significantly reduce transportation costs and time.
 
 
 
• **Coastal Karnataka**
 
 
• Karnataka has a coastline of about 300 kilometers along the Arabian Sea.
 
• It is home to several important ports including New Mangalore, Karwar, and Belekeri.
 
• The coastal region is known for its rich maritime history and is a hub for fishing and maritime trade.
 
• Karnataka's coastal line plays a significant role in its tourism industry as well.
